decision_safeguards.acquisition_numeric_instability: sensitivity median B80 Jaccard <0.25 together with absolute mean q20 AULC change >=0.01, or sensitivity optimizer convergence <0.80
decision_safeguards.early_or_late_gain: region interval above zero while the other region is not clearly below zero
decision_safeguards.severe_global_degradation: at B40 or B80, mean P1-P0 full81 accuracy <= -0.02 or Keyhole recall <= -0.05

endpoints.primary: Fold-B1-q20 accuracy normalized trapezoidal AULC B16-B80

inference.unit: 20 paired repeat blocks; five folds retained together

model.stage1: training-fitted log(h) latent logistic mean, revealed labels only, then frozen

primary_comparison.P0: M3 evaluator on frozen A0 path
primary_comparison.P1: same M3 evaluator on sequential M3-margin path

sensitivity.selection_rule: one deterministic cycling fold per repeat: fold=((repeat-1) mod 5)+1
